packs.simulationCaption: Classical meditation seat: stabilize pelvis before lengthening spine.

steps.label: Sit evenly
steps.instruction: Place a folded blanket so both sit bones rest evenly. Lengthen the spine without lifting the ribs.

steps.label: Cross ankles
steps.instruction: Bring one heel toward perineum, opposite ankle in front. Keep knees below hip line — never force rotation from the knee.

steps.label: Settle hold
steps.instruction: Soften shoulders, close eyes or lower gaze. Breath becomes quiet and diaphragmatic — preparation for pranayama.

steps.label: Meditative stillness
steps.instruction: Maintain sthira-sukham: steady without strain. This is the classical nadi-shuddhi seat (T1 framework).

videos.title: Beginners practice — seated alignment principles
videos.note: Focus on hip elevation and knee comfort rather than forcing lotus. Verified embed — scrub to the relevant segment.

anatomyRegions.label: Hip rotators
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: External rotation load; avoid knee torque.

anatomyRegions.label: Axial spine
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Neutral lumbar curve for prolonged sitting.

packs.biomechanicsCaption: Low metabolic demand; primary load is hip external rotation and axial endurance for meditation.

packs.simulationCaption: Kneeling upright seat — often used for post-meal comfort, not intense glucose disposal.

steps.label: Kneel
steps.instruction: Kneel with tops of feet on floor, big toes touching. Place blanket between calves and thighs if needed.

steps.label: Sit on heels
steps.instruction: Lower hips toward heels keeping spine tall. Hands rest on thighs.

steps.label: Upright rest
steps.instruction: Allow abdomen to settle without collapsing the chest. Breathe slowly through the nose.

steps.label: Digestive seat hold
steps.instruction: Hold comfortably after meals if knees tolerate it — comfort seat, not a substitute for walking.

videos.title: Iyengar Yoga Tutorial — kneeling seats
videos.note: Use props if knee compression is uncomfortable. Verified embed — scrub to the relevant segment.

anatomyRegions.label: Knee flexion
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Deep flexion — caution with arthritis.

anatomyRegions.label: Abdominal viscera
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Gentle compression at rest; post-meal comfort claim not trial-proven.

packs.biomechanicsCaption: Minimal muscle recruitment; upright kneeling alters abdominal orientation at rest.

packs.simulationCaption: Seated spinal twist — Gheranda T1 agni claim; rotate from thoracic spine, not forced lumbar drag.

steps.label: Base seat
steps.instruction: Sit with one foot flat outside opposite thigh (or legs extended for milder version). Lengthen spine.

steps.label: Hook elbow
steps.instruction: Place opposite elbow outside knee; other hand behind for support.

steps.label: Thoracic twist
steps.instruction: Inhale lengthen; exhale rotate chest toward knee. Keep both sit bones grounded.

steps.label: Hold & breathe
steps.instruction: Hold 5–8 breaths. Avoid forcing — pregnancy and acute disc pain are apavarga (exceptions).

videos.title: Iyengar Yoga Tutorial — twist family
videos.note: Classical Gheranda links this family to digestive fire (T1) — not proven pancreatic stimulation. Verified embed — scrub to the relevant segment.

anatomyRegions.label: Thoracic rotation
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Primary rotation segment; protect lumbar from over-twisting.

anatomyRegions.label: Obliques / trunk
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Modest muscular work (B1).

packs.biomechanicsCaption: Trunk rotation with abdominal compression; no evidence that twist 'massages pancreas' into insulin release.

packs.simulationCaption: Posterior-chain fold — hinge from hips; Gheranda T1 agni association.

steps.label: Dandasana base
steps.instruction: Sit with legs extended, flex feet. Inhale and lengthen spine.

steps.label: Hip hinge
steps.instruction: Fold forward from hip joints keeping spine long — not from collapsing the chest.

steps.label: Reach shins
steps.instruction: Hold shins, ankles, or strap. Keep neck in line with spine.

steps.label: Calm hold
steps.instruction: Relax shoulders; avoid pulling head to knees. Pitta-cooling when gentle (A1).

videos.title: Iyengar Yoga Tutorial — seated forward fold cues
videos.note: Modify for disc symptoms and sciatica. Verified embed — scrub to the relevant segment.

anatomyRegions.label: Hamstrings
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Posterior-chain stretch; neural tension if forced.

anatomyRegions.label: Spinal flexion
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Flexion-intolerant backs need modification.

packs.biomechanicsCaption: Passive hold = low glucose disposal; dynamic repetitions recruit more muscle (B1).

packs.simulationCaption: Chair pose — large-muscle isometric; strongest glucose plausibility in seated/standing family when held.

steps.label: Tadasana start
steps.instruction: Stand with feet together or hip-width. Arms at sides.

steps.label: Sit back
steps.instruction: Bend knees and sit hips back as if toward a chair. Arms reach forward or overhead.

steps.label: Hold chair
steps.instruction: Knees track over toes; weight toward heels. Quadriceps isometrically fire.

steps.label: Active hold
steps.instruction: Hold 30 seconds for metabolic load. Useful post-meal movement alternative (B1-B2 plausibility).

videos.title: Iyengar Yoga Tutorial — standing poses
videos.note: Emphasizes grounding back leg and knee tracking. Verified embed — scrub to the relevant segment.

anatomyRegions.label: Quadriceps
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Primary isometric loaders — GLUT4 plausibility (B1).

anatomyRegions.label: Gluteals
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Hip extension control in squat.

packs.biomechanicsCaption: Sustained large-muscle isometric work supports contraction-mediated glucose uptake when appropriately dosed.

packs.simulationCaption: Tree pose — Gheranda's only classical standing asana; balance and proprioception focus.

steps.label: Root foot
steps.instruction: Stand on one leg; spread toes of standing foot like roots.

steps.label: Foot to ankle
steps.instruction: Place opposite foot on inner ankle or calf — never on the knee joint.

steps.label: Hands to heart
steps.instruction: Palms at chest or arms overhead. Fix a steady drishti (gaze point).

steps.label: Balance hold
steps.instruction: Hold while breathing steadily. Use wall if fall risk is meaningful.

videos.title: Iyengar Yoga Tutorial — standing balance family
videos.note: Wall support demonstrated for beginners and elders. Verified embed — scrub to the relevant segment.

anatomyRegions.label: Standing ankle
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Proprioceptive challenge; fall risk with vertigo.

anatomyRegions.label: Standing hip stabilizers
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Gluteus medius/minimus recruitment.

packs.biomechanicsCaption: Neuromotor demand exceeds metabolic demand; excellent for indriya/buddhi training (A1).

packs.simulationCaption: Extended triangle — Iyengar foundational standing pose; legs active, chest open.

steps.label: Wide stance
steps.instruction: Step feet wide; turn front foot out 90°, back foot slightly in.

steps.label: Reach forward
steps.instruction: Extend trunk over front leg; both legs stay straight and active.

steps.label: Lower hand
steps.instruction: Place hand on block, ankle, or floor. Top arm reaches to ceiling; open chest.

steps.label: Triangle hold
steps.instruction: Hold 30–60 seconds. Ground back foot; lengthen both sides of waist evenly.

videos.title: Triangle Pose | Trikonasana | Foundations of Yoga
videos.note: Detailed foot grounding and trunk forward action — aligns with Light on Yoga pedagogy. Verified embed — scrub to the relevant segment.

anatomyRegions.label: Leg isometrics
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Large-muscle hold — B1-B2 glucose plausibility when sustained.

anatomyRegions.label: Thoracic opening
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Chest rotation away from floor resists gravity.

packs.biomechanicsCaption: Combines leg endurance, lateral hip control, and thoracic rotation — iconic Iyengar standing pose.

packs.simulationCaption: Downward dog — inverted V; upper-limb load with mild head-down physiology.

steps.label: Tabletop
steps.instruction: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

steps.label: Lift hips
steps.instruction: Tuck toes; lift hips up and back forming an inverted V.

steps.label: Press hands
steps.instruction: Press palms; externally rotate upper arms. Heels descend without forcing.

steps.label: Hold dog
steps.instruction: Hold 5 breaths or longer. Modify for glaucoma/retinopathy (head-down caution).

referencePhoto.alt: Adho Mukha Svanasana downward facing dog

videos.title: Yoga For Complete Beginners (Downward Dog section)
videos.note: Common vinyasa transition pose; caution with wrist and shoulder pathology. Verified embed — scrub to the relevant segment.

anatomyRegions.label: Shoulder girdle
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Weight-bearing through wrists — modify with blocks.

anatomyRegions.label: Posterior chain
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Hamstrings and calves lengthen; no special insulin advantage (B0-B1).

packs.biomechanicsCaption: Upper-limb loading plus posterior-chain length; hydrostatic changes do not equal metabolic benefit.

packs.simulationCaption: Corpse pose — integration, parasympathetic downshift, mandatory practice closure.

steps.label: Lie supine
steps.instruction: Lie on back; feet fall open, arms slightly away from body, palms up.

steps.label: Support
steps.instruction: Use blanket under head, bolster under knees if lumbar or pregnancy modifications needed.

steps.label: Release
steps.instruction: Scan body for residual tension; soften jaw, shoulders, belly.

steps.label: Integrate
steps.instruction: Remain 5–15 minutes. Primary pathway is stress recovery, not glucose disposal.

videos.title: Center Day 1 — includes Shavasana closing
videos.note: Supports manas settling and vata-pitta calming inference (A1). Verified embed — scrub to the relevant segment.

anatomyRegions.label: Diaphragmatic breath
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Minimal muscular work; HRV/stress pathway (B1 indirect).

anatomyRegions.label: Whole-body rest
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Integration pose — not exercise for glucose disposal.

packs.biomechanicsCaption: Minimal acute glucose uptake; indirect benefit via stress/sleep/adherence pathways (B0-B1).

packs.simulationCaption: Headstand preparation — advanced inversion; high safety stakes, no glycemic special indication.

steps.label: Dolphin base
steps.instruction: Forearms on mat, interlace fingers — never jump into headstand.

steps.label: Crown placement
steps.instruction: Place crown lightly on floor between forearms; most weight on forearms not crown.

steps.label: Lift legs
steps.instruction: Walk feet in or controlled lift with core engagement; use wall for learning.

steps.label: Vertical hold
steps.instruction: Hold only with stable alignment. Contraindicated: glaucoma, uncontrolled BP, cervical disease.

videos.title: Iyengar alignment principles (inversions — expert only)
videos.note: Modern form is textually contested vs classical viparita karani mudra (T2). Disproportionate injury reports in case literature. Verified embed — scrub to the relevant segment.

anatomyRegions.label: Cervical spine
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Axial load risk — absolute caution with cervical pathology.

anatomyRegions.label: Intraocular pressure
anatomyRegions.clinicalNote: Head-down posture raises IOP — glaucoma/retinopathy apavarga.

packs.biomechanicsCaption: Advanced inversion; hydrostatic and ocular effects without established glycemic advantage.
